instruction: Candid corporate medium shot from a slightly low angle in a bright office. The woman with dark brown hair in a dark blue blazer (R1) on the left laughs in profile, raising her arm high. Next to her, the woman with curly dark hair in a black blazer (R4) and the woman with long dark brown hair in a black blazer (R3) look up and smile, raising their arms. On the right, the blonde woman in a teal top (R2) smiles in profile. Their hands are joined high in a celebratory team stack under bright, natural indoor light.
